combo_label: The Pub × Silly English Things × Dracula & Gothic Horror

entries.clue: West Country pub bowling down a long alley
Vital red fluid the count crosses Europe to drink
Horse-chestnut duel fought on shoelaces in the playground
Chamber beneath a church floor; a cackling puppet Keeper told tales from one on TV
Blessed font liquid flung at the unclean thing
Hot counter where a chef slices roast meat onto Sunday plates
Cash drawer behind the bar, ringing each time it slides open
Almost black beer, roasted in flavour and crowned with cream
Pleated ribbon badge pinned on a prize marrow or a winning pony
Slow crumbling of timber and plaster in a house shut up for fifty years
Punch's put-upon wife in the striped-tent puppet show
